**Coaching Note:**
When your opponent moves a piece to an undefended square, look for ways to attack it with check or another forcing move. Here, Ng4 is loose and the bishop can capture with check, winning the knight by force. Before moving, always scan: can I attack an undefended piece with check, discovery, or double threat?
